subject: PO acceptance language & early-invoice sprint for usage billing
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@aurelia-labs.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aurelia-labs.com
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurelia PO requirements + invoice cadence question

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo earlier — Aurelia is excited to move forward. Our procurement team sent over a PO template (attached) and flagged a few mandatory clauses for our AP system:

- PO must reference the Redwood Master Services Agreement (MSA) and the exact SOW title.
- Net terms: Net 45 preferred (we can escalate to Net 30 if required by finance).
- Invoice cadence: they only accept monthly statements but will process weekly 'early invoices' for usage overrun only if the invoice references a valid PO and a committed prepayment or preauth.
- PO field: requires an explicit 'Service Activation Date' line and a single PO number mapped to the invoice header.

Can you confirm Redwood can accept PO field mapping as-is and whether we can support weekly early invoices for overages if we include a preauthorized credit hold? Also attached our template for reference.

Sara
Procurement Lead | Aurelia Labs
Attachments: Aurelia_PO_Template.pdf

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@aurelia-labs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurelia PO requirements + invoice cadence question

Sara — thanks for the template and the clear callouts. Short answers up front:

- We can accept a PO that references the Redwood Inference MSA + SOW title and include the PO number in the invoice header.
- Net 45 is acceptable; we typically price to Net 30 but will approve Net 45 for this enterprise agreement given the committed annual spend.
- Weekly early invoices for overages are possible if Aurelia provides a preauthorized credit/advance or if we issue invoices to an agreed 'early-invoice' ledger. We'll need the PO to explicitly allow weekly overage invoices and the billing contact to preauthorize charge caps.

I'll loop Karthik (billing lead) and Marissa (finance ops) to confirm the invoicing workflow and the exact wording we should ask procurement to add to the PO. If you'd like, we can propose the PO clause language.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sara Kim <sara.kim@aurelia-labs.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 12:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurelia PO requirements + invoice cadence question

Hi all — quick technical clarification from billing:

- We can map 'Service Activation Date' to the invoice header (we send metadata fields: PO#, ServiceStart, AccountNumber).
- For weekly early invoices on overages: we need a single PO that allows incremental invoicing against the same PO number; the PO needs to include a line item called 'Usage Overage (if any) - billed weekly' or similar.
- Regarding preauth: Aurelia's procurement should indicate a preauthorized hold amount or an approved 'advance credit' in the PO memo; otherwise our system will batch usage and only issue monthly statements.

Suggested PO language (copy/paste):
"Aurelia Labs authorizes Redwood Inference to issue incremental weekly invoices against PO# {PO_NUMBER} for usage overages, provided such invoices reference the PO number and any invoice against the PO will be settled under Net 45 terms. A preauthorized credit hold of $X,XXX is established to cover interim overage invoices."

If you confirm the preauth amount or prefer Redwood to suggest a cap based on expected monthly usage, we can draft a finalized clause.

Karthik Iyer
Billing Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@aurelia-labs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aurelia-labs.com, Josh Perry <josh.perry@aurelia-labs.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurelia PO requirements + invoice cadence question

Thanks Karthik — that language is helpful. Procurement asked us to propose a conservative preauth amount: $7,500 (one week of our expected overage at current usage projections). They also want the PO to explicitly state:

- Net 45 terms apply to all invoices unless otherwise mutually agreed.
- A single PO number will be used; incremental invoices are allowed and will reference the same PO.
- Any invoice disputes will be logged to procurement and AP within 10 business days.

Can Redwood confirm whether $7,500 preauth would be acceptable as a credit hold and whether you need a different format for the PO memo? If that's good we'll send the updated template and push to our AP for processing.

Sara

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@aurelia-labs.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurelia PO requirements + invoice cadence question

Sara — good to confirm. Redwood accepts the $7,500 preauthorized credit hold as a mechanism to support weekly overage invoices. A couple of final notes for the PO:

1) Please include the exact SOW title we have in our SOW ("Aurelia Labs — Redwood Inference Usage & Dedicated Support SOW v3") and reference Redwood MSA ID #RWI-2026-MSA in the PO memo.
2) Use the PO memo line: "Authorize weekly incremental invoices for usage overage against PO# {PO_NUMBER}; Net 45 applies; preauthorized credit hold $7,500"
3) Billing will send an initial monthly statement on the 1st of the next month and then weekly overage invoices if threshold exceeded; all invoices will show the PO# and Service Activation Date.

I'll ask Marissa to run the billing mapping and confirm the invoice header layout (PDF sample) and route the DocuSign link for the SOW + PO acceptance if you want a signed agreement trail.

Thanks — excited to get this live.
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Redwood_SOW_v3.pdf
